## Proposed Concept / Program

## Which Level?

- [ ] Basics (01-50: syntax, slices, maps, structs, pointers, etc.)
- [ ] Intermediate (51-100: interfaces, testing, HTTP, concurrency basics)
- [ ] Advanced (101-150: generics, reflection, profiling, patterns, unsafe, etc.)
- [ ] Documentation / tooling improvement

## Why Should This Be Added?

Explain the learning value. What will learners understand after this program?
How does it fit the progressive curriculum?
